title: fix: use correct content-type for container registry response (#39398)
body:
spec: https://github.com/opencontainers/distribution-spec/blob/main/spec.md

* `/v2/<name>/manifests/<reference>`: media type
* `/v2/<name>/blobs/<digest>` : binary content (spec doesn't require content type)
